##### SECTION M6 (-L (and -c) mismatch between a full receive and a later incremental, both directions)  tag=C  zfs-2.4.1-1ubuntu5.1
=== CASE M6/big.00_src_props
--- cmd
zfs get -H -o name,property,value recordsize zfsbcapc/M6/cs/big
--- rc
0
--- stdout
zfsbcapc/M6/cs/big	recordsize	1M
--- stderr
=== END
